verdict.rationale: Steel's own CLI documents click/fill/type commands, but nothing shows these act on natural-language-described elements or survive selector and layout changes. The 'snapshot' tool, the Computer Use integrations and Browser-Use are framework integrations, not Steel's own DOM-understanding act primitives. They are adjacent capabilities, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drive the page through DOM-understanding action primitives (act/click/type on described elements) that survive selector and layout changes
